jobs.name: Weekly AI Services & Docker Stacks Upgrade
jobs.description: Same as the user crontab line: upgrades the AI services and the media/karakeep stacks, verifies them (auto-heal + Slack on failure), then checks every API token. Output goes to services/AI/upgrade.log.

jobs.name: Supabase Project Keepalive
jobs.description: Pings registered Supabase projects to prevent free-tier inactivity pausing. Scheduled by the supabase-keepalive systemd timer (Sun and Wed 03:30), not cron.
